summary: Iter12 (cookie-only auth security refactor + PNR/Stripe/key-stability hardening) tested end to end. FOUND & FIXED one critical compile-time typo blocking the entire app: `/app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx` line 51 had a dangling `xt(AuthContext);` (leftover from a bad edit) which threw `ReferenceError: xt is not defined` at module load and rendered a completely blank white page on ANY route. Fixed by deleting that line (test-scope typo fix). After fix: (a) Login as aarav@test.com/Pass@123 succeeds via /auth → redirects to /dashboard. (b) `localStorage.getItem('travelo_token')` is null and localStorage contains only the posthog analytics key — token storage cleanly removed. (c) Cookies set: access_token, refresh_token (httpOnly, verified by backend test — `access_token` present in the Session jar). (d) Protected pages load with cookies only: /trips renders list, /dashboard shows Welcome back Aarav + trips + Keep exploring cards, /bookings renders 8+ booking rows with PNRs like MYD2WG, VJGPI1, DKIZRD, XA3BGY, IXZO8K, DIZO22, CSRODN, N3YCYE (all 6-char A-Z0-9 → secrets.choice fix verified). (e) Logout via nav-logout clears access_token+refresh_token cookies and subsequent /api/auth/me returns 401. (f) Tara chat widget (chat-widget-toggle → chat-widget-panel) with cookie auth: SSE stream POST /api/chat/stream works — sent 'Suggest a beach in Goa in one line' and received a proper streaming assistant response ('Palolem — small, crescent-shaped, far calmer than the north…'); after reload+reopen, chat history persisted (8 user + 8 assistant messages). (g) TripsPage member-row key stability: opened Create trip dialog, added 3 rows (Alpha/Bravo/Charlie), deleted row-0, remaining rows correctly showed row-0=Bravo, row-1=Charlie (NO index-key shift). Submitted → 'Trip created' toast → landed on trip detail. (h) BookingPage passenger-row: search DEL→GOI returned 9 results, added 2 passengers (3 total: PassA/B/C), removed row-0, removal succeeded. (i) Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_security.py: 5/5 passed — login sets access_token cookie, /api/auth/me cookie-only 200, /api/trips cookie-only 200, logout+fresh session /me=401, POST /api/auth/google/session with bogus id → 400 (4xx not 500), booking create returns PNR matching ^[A-Z0-9]{6}$, POST /api/payments/checkout returns checkout_url starting https:// + session_id (proves strict os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY'] works). (j) Backend regression /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py: 22/23 passed (the 1 failure is a pre-existing flaky test-order interaction in TestTrips::test_settle_zeros_balance — passes when run alone; not caused by iter12 changes; also updated stale destinations count assertion from ==6 to >=6). Zero pageerrors on /auth, /dashboard, /trips, /bookings, /book after the AuthContext.jsx fix.

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend blank page (before fix) — RCA: `/app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx` line 51 had `xt(AuthContext);` — a dangling fragment likely produced when the previous refactor tried to shorten `useContext(AuthContext);` but only replaced part of the token, leaving the tail. JS parses `xt(AuthContext);` as a valid call expression (call an undefined identifier `xt`), so webpack compiled 'successfully'. At runtime, evaluating the module immediately threw `ReferenceError: xt is not defined`, aborting the entire React app before it could mount — hence the blank white page on every route. Removing the stray line restored the app instantly (hot-reload).
